items.title: Invalid mouse focus when releasing the cursor after a text selection

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue identified by VS Code Team member as probable bug

items.body:
Type: Bug VSCode does not respect mouse focus when releasing the cursor after a text selection. In traditional Windows apps, a mouse release when selecting text in a `TextEdit` does not execute a `MouseUp` action when the cursor move outside the control. As you can see in this screencast, a `MouseUp` action in executed on the current scope (visible when Sticky Scroll is enabled) while « quickly » selecting text in the search control. ![Animation](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/assets/22446243/28326970-6d9f-4360-8f65-b56bbd408036) VS Code version: Code - Insiders 1.80.0-insider (73eb619afb87cab4aa83a569259c891b6983c11e, 2023-06-19T05:35:37.388Z) OS version: Windows_NT x64 10.0.19045 Modes:
